name: fastly-mcp
description: Use the Fastly API through a local MCP server

interface.longDescription:
Find Fastly API methods, inspect their parameters, and run focused JavaScript with a preconfigured Fastly client.
Investigate services, backends, TLS, caching, and traffic, or make changes with a token that permits them.
The MCP server runs locally and uses the Fastly API token you configure in your client environment.
Install either Bun or Node.js 24.12.0 or newer before connecting.
The bundled launcher uses bunx; see the README for Bun-only and Node.js-only launch settings.
Node.js is recommended for remote mode.
For production changes, review the planned call and approve it before execution.
